namespaces.skills: What a skill says and does: content, triggers, invocation policy, relationships between skills, and evaluating whether skills behave.
namespaces.packages: How things get bundled and delivered: package definitions, sources, catalog, enable/disable lifecycle, apply engine.
namespaces.agent-config: What harnesses read other than skills: rules, hooks, permissions, settings, MCP registration, cross-harness parity, and inspecting that configuration.
namespaces.harness: Harness provider architecture: registry, adapters, per-provider capability model.
namespaces.plans: The plan suite: schema, validation, repair, authoring workflow, lifecycle transitions, and the Plans page.
namespaces.onboarding: A new user's path from first install to first useful result, in the terminal or the portal.
namespaces.git: Local Git and the Git host, GitHub first: worktrees, branches, Git execution, agent identity on the host, pull request and CI workflows, host-specific permission rules, and the host module.
namespaces.release: Publishing and distributing RoboRepo itself: registry releases, Homebrew, release artifacts.
namespaces.local-data: What RoboRepo keeps on the user's machine: generated stores, retention, user-owned data, portable profiles and backup.
namespaces.runtime: The Runtime service: local dev server discovery, Docker/Compose grouping, repo cards.
namespaces.telemetry: Agent session telemetry: capture, classification, phase inference, metrics, cohorts, experiments, analysis. Tokens are one captured field among ~30 (alongside test-failure streaks, edit/read counts, phase signals), which is why the namespace is not named for them. The portal routes this at /tokens because token cost is what a user goes there to read.
namespaces.session: Agent session launching, attachment, terminal integration.
